comment: M5-003 sample rows: one attack reaction per legacy melee attack. control_penetration is none for all four - the legacy game has no poise bypass, and bypass_poise (the only other supported value) would skip a target's poise threshold but never its explicit allow gates, blanket control immunity or get-up protection. The hit magnitudes (stun, knockback, launch, hit stop) live in damage_profiles.json; this table carries only the control-strength policy.
